model.front_windows: Eight mix16B windows input+0..112 / secret+0..127 in step 16, each with seed, summed into acc starting at len * PRIME64_1 (movabs 0x9e3779b185ebca87 at 0x61d7dc0); the sum is then XXH3_avalanche'd (0x61d7f18..0x61d7f2d, multiplier 0x165667919e3779f9)
model.middle_windows: One mix16B per round i = 8 .. nbRounds-1 (nbRounds = len >> 4) at input+16*i against secret+16*(i-8)+3: (input+128/secret+3), (input+144/secret+19), (input+160/secret+35), (input+176/secret+51), (input+192/secret+67), (input+208/secret+83), (input+224/secret+99). The gates are cmp $0x8..$0xd,$0xf against %r10d (0x61d7f30..0x61d8046); the i=14 window runs only at len 240
model.tail: return XXH3_avalanche(avalanche(front) + mix16B(input+len-16, secret+119, seed) + middle mixes). The trailing window's secret offset is 119 = XXH3_SECRET_SIZE_MIN (136) - 17; its secret words sit at +0x77/+0x7f. The disassembly folds the trailing mix first (r9 at 0x61d7f05) and the middle mixes after; the transliteration follows that order and the reference folds middles first -- addition commutes, so agreement validates the sum
model.trailing_window: mix16B(input+len-16, secret+119, seed), always run, folded into the same accumulator as the middle mixes (r9, added to the avalanched front sum at 0x61d8077)

return_value: 64-bit hash in %rax. The 64-bit one-shots return it directly; the withSecret/withSeed entry points tail-jump here so the value is their return value for lengths 129..240

semantics.middle_loop_note: The middle loop runs one window per round i while i < len//16: at len 240 (len//16 == 15) all seven middle windows run including i=14 (input+224/secret+99); at len 129..143 none run
semantics.scope: Lengths 129..240 only, the len_129to240 helper at 0x61d7dc0. Lengths 0..128 are the inline short branches of the three 64-bit entry points; the >240 hashLong helpers (0x61d8510 / 0x61d9090) are delegation targets only and are out of scope here; the 128-bit variant at 0x61d80a0 is a sibling, not reconstructed here
semantics.seed_term: The seed is added to the low secret word and subtracted from the high secret word in every mix16B, front, middle and trailing alike. The secretSize argument is never read

side_effects: The function writes no memory, calls nothing, and reads only [data, data+len) and the secret windows listed in the model. It pushes/pops only %r12 (never otherwise used; kept for stack alignment) and restores all callee-saved registers
